words.gloss: he who has a small army
he who has a large army

literal: If he who has a small army reaches a place suitable to go, the morale of him who has a large army will be completely destroyed.
translation: If a leader with a small army reaches a battlefield suited to his strength, the morale of the enemy with a massive army will be utterly shattered.
modern: சிறிய படையை உடையவன் தனக்கு ஏற்ற இடத்தைச் சென்றடைந்தால், பெரிய படையை உடையவனுடைய ஊக்கம் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location in strategy. Even a commander with a small force can defeat a much larger force if they secure a strategic position that favors them. Once the smaller force occupies this advantageous ground, the confidence and morale of the larger army will collapse, leading to their defeat. The word 'உறு' here means large or abundant, contrasting with 'சிறு' (small), showing that strategic positioning overcomes numerical superiority.
